title: Jameh Mosque of Isfahan
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Jameh Mosque of Isfahan:map-exact irregular low brick complex and two courtyards,four distinct deep pointed iwans/two-storey court arcade fields,larger south and smaller north pale-brick domes,twin south minarets,west timber lookout,blue central basin and low arched pavilion. Five shared256² brick/mosaic/plaster/stone/wood graphs,six merged groups,four browser levels. All untagged vertical dimensions and subplans explicitly picture-estimated;fine facade art,interiors and exact terrain/threshold joins omitted or unverified.
